prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 11 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1185; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the patient was changing lanes, with complaints of neck and back pain described as strain-type in nature. Over the course of 11 visits, care consisted of conservative management including manual therapy, stretching, and home exercise instruction. Treatment followed a typical course, with frequency reduced as symptoms improved and the patient was progressively discharged from active care. Examination findings include reduced cervical and lumbar range of motion and localized muscle tenderness that support a soft tissue injury, while neurological screening and imaging-related assessments remained within normal limits. No prior injury to the same body regions is reported in the available history. At this time, it is not yet clear whether the presenting symptoms are fully attributable to this collision, and further records are being reviewed to clarify the relationship. Billing entries for two similar services on the same date are under review for accuracy.
